correctness.rationale: The complete 7-vertex facet list is generated by 14 modular translates. Every one of the 99 induced subcomplexes with 3–7 vertices was enumerated and its integral H1 presentation reduced; all its nonzero Smith factors are 1. The four horizontal integral inclusion matrices have sizes 49×21, 42×49, 14×42, 2×14, ranks 20,29,12,2 and exclusively unit Smith factors. All compositions vanish; the resulting H1-line horizontal ranks are 1,0,1,0,0. The oriented torus contributes its top class and the empty set contributes the unit. All vertical and horizontal groups are torsion-free, so duality yields the stated integral HH cohomology, not merely field Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The unique minimum-vertex triangulation of the orientable genus-one surface is a canonical, intrinsically motivated non-spherical test of moment-angle double cohomology. The exact torsion-free four-bidegree profile, especially the two surviving first-homology inclusion survivors at subset sizes 3 and 5, determines data not supplied by the torus ordinary homology, Golodness, or the published seven-cycle and sphere tables. It is a complete exact natural invariant for a distinguished object, usable to test higher-genus conjectures.
